name: 2MASX J15322270+4150586, ASASSN-15mg field (Hubble)
blurb: 2MASX J15322270+4150586, a galaxy that hosted the Type Ia supernova ASASSN-15mg, seen by Hubble.
label: asassn15mg-hubble
story: The Type Ia supernova ASASSN-15mg flared in this galaxy and was caught by an automated sky survey. Hubble came back later to measure the faint light that lingers at a supernova's site.

claims.text: ASASSN-15mg was discovered by ASAS-SN in the galaxy 2MASX J15322270+4150586
ASASSN-15mg was classified as a Type Ia supernova
Program 15166 images sites of recent supernovae to obtain late-time photometry
